basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Project Assistant (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai (Dist.- Durg, Chhattisgarh) has invited applications for one Project Assistant post in a CSR-funded project, on consolidated pay of Rs. 20,000 to 25,000 for a duration of 89 days. The essential qualification is a Diploma in Animal Husbandry from a recognised institution or university, with a minimum of 6 months of relevant experience. The duly filled application form and a detailed CV must be emailed to [email protected], with the Principal Investigator at [email protected] in CC, on or before 18 November 2026, 5:30 PM. The interview is on 19 November

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form attached to the notice (Annexure-III). It asks for personal details, education details starting from matriculation, professional experience, and awards, patents and prizes, and ends with a declaration and signature.
Email the form and CV to [email protected].
Put the Principal Investigator, [email protected], in CC.
Send the email on or before 18 November 2026, 5:30 PM.
Documents named in the notice: the duly filled application form and a detailed CV.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. Extensive travel is required to report in IIT Bhilai from the work location, Mohla-Manpur and adjacent places in Chhattisgarh. The selected candidate has to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The letterhead gives [email protected] as the institute's email address; applications go to the address given under How to Apply.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Project Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Mohla-Manpur, and adjacent places in Chhattisgarh

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai, Dist.- Durg, Chhattisgarh - 491001 (website: www.iitbhilai.ac.in ). The post supports the implementation, administration and technical monitoring of the institute's CSR-funded projects. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Jose Immanuel R., Associate Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in Animal Husbandry from a recognised institution or university. Experience: minimum 6 months of relevant experience in poultry farming or animal husbandry. The notice lists the following under experience: Poultry farm operations and routine poultry care activities. Artificial insemination and related animal husbandry activities. Supporting day-to-day farm activities and operational requirements. Computer operations, data entry, documentation and record maintenance. Field-level coordination, communication and interaction with farmers or community members. Age: upper age limit 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. For eligibility details, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is 20,000 to 25,000 (Consolidated pay) and the duration is 89 days. The notice says the appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency applicable to the project as and when required. The selected candidate has to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The notice states that the fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance till date is not deemed satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Bhilai Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form attached to the notice (Annexure-III). It asks for personal details, education details starting from matriculation, professional experience, and awards, patents and prizes, and ends with a declaration and signature. Prepare a detailed CV. Email the form and CV to [email protected] . Put the Principal Investigator, [email protected] , in CC. Send the email on or before 18 November 2026, 5:30 PM. Documents named in the notice: the duly filled application form and a detailed CV.

The selected candidate has to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The letterhead gives [email protected] as the institute's email address; applications go to the address given under How to Apply.
